facts.text: The Rittenhouse is at 210 West Rittenhouse Square in Philadelphia.
facts.excerpt:
210 West Rittenhouse Square

Philadelphia, PA

facts.text: The hotel has an atrium pool and a spa.
facts.excerpt: our relaxing atrium pool and rejuvenating treatments from the spa

facts.text: Lacroix overlooks Rittenhouse Square and has been a fixture on the square for over two decades.
facts.excerpt: A beloved fixture on Rittenhouse Square for over two decades, Lacroix has evolved into a modern expression of refined dining

facts.text: Lacroix blends French bistro influence with global flavors and has an expertly curated wine cellar.
facts.excerpt: where French bistro influence meets global flavors, and the cocktail program is as considered as the cuisine. Expect seasonally driven menus crafted with the finest local ingredients, an expertly curated wine cellar

facts.text: The Library Bar, just off the lobby, is a book-lined bar with a curated collection of fine and rare books about Philadelphia.
facts.excerpt: explore a curated collection of fine and rare books—ranging from Philadelphia’s storied past to its vibrant creative present

facts.text: The Library Bar is a hideaway just off the lobby serving classic cocktails, rare spirits and small plates.
facts.excerpt: A spirited hideaway just off the lobby, The Library Bar is where classic cocktails, rare spirits, and thoughtful small plates come together in an intimate, book-lined setting.

facts.text: Afternoon tea is served in the Mary Cassatt Tea Room and is best enjoyed with a reservation.
facts.excerpt: Nestled within the Mary Cassatt Tea Room, this cherished ritual is best enjoyed with a reservation.

facts.text: Each room overlooks Rittenhouse Square or the city.
facts.excerpt: Each of our Rittenhouse hotel rooms quietly overlooks Rittenhouse Square or the city.

facts.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms with Acqua Di Parma bath amenities.
facts.excerpt: Luxurious marble bathroom featuring Acqua Di Parma bath amenities

facts.text: Rooms get twice daily housekeeping including evening turndown and overnight shoe shining.
facts.excerpt: Twice daily housekeeping including evening turndown service

facts.text: Guest rooms measure between 450 and 600 square feet.
facts.excerpt: Our guest rooms are generously proportioned, measuring between 450 and 600 square feet

facts.text: Specialty Suites have one or two bedrooms, entertainment and dining areas, and a kitchenette.
facts.excerpt: Featuring 1 or 2 bedrooms, inviting entertainment and dining areas, and a kitchenette, Specialty Suites have all the essentials

facts.text: Pet-friendly suites are available.
facts.excerpt: Pet-friendly suites available

facts.text: The newly redesigned Mary Cassatt Suite has an oversized living area, kitchenette and dining area.
facts.excerpt: the newly redesigned Mary Cassatt Suite offers a historical luxury with an oversized living area, kitchenette, and dining area

facts.text: In-room dining serves dishes from Lacroix.
facts.excerpt: Savor curated dishes from Lacroix, thoughtfully prepared and delivered to the comfort and privacy of your room.

facts.text: The hotel has over 12,000 square feet of event space for meetings, weddings and social gatherings.
facts.excerpt: With over 12,000 square feet of versatile event space, The Rittenhouse provides an exceptional setting for meetings, weddings, and social gatherings of every scale.

facts.text: The building's cantilevered facade was designed to give as many rooms as possible park views, creating pointed corner nooks.
facts.excerpt: the building’s cantilevered facade was designed to create generous park views in as many rooms as possible, creating pointed corner nooks

facts.text: The Rittenhouse Spa and Club has an indoor pool, outdoor sun deck, fitness center, full-service spa and salon.
facts.excerpt: The on-site spa, The Rittenhouse Spa and Club - Hair by Paul Labrecque, is a glorious urban escape complete with an indoor pool, outdoor sun deck, fitness center, full-service spa and salon, plus men’s grooming station.

facts.text: Not all rooms have king-size beds.
facts.excerpt: Not all rooms have king-size beds, so be sure to read the fine print before booking

facts.text: The hotel calls itself Philadelphia's premier French dining and event destination.
facts.excerpt: The Rittenhouse is Philadelphia's premier French dining and event destination.

facts.text: Lacroix is a AAA Four Diamond Award restaurant.
facts.excerpt: the AAA Four Diamond Award restaurant heralded as one of the finest in the U.S.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes that Parc is just across the square.
facts.excerpt: (Stephen Starr's Parc is just across the square after all.)

contradictions.note: p8 (Condé Nast Traveler) recommends dinner at Scarpetta; official dining page p6 lists Lacroix, Library Bar, Mary Cassatt Tea Room and no Scarpetta. Scarpetta excluded.
